rubrics_metrics.name: UN Atomic Energy Conference paper submission deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Papers (titles and the papers themselves) for the U.N. Atomic Energy Conference must be submitted to the U.N. Secretary-General by specified deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states: 'PAPERS MUST BE SUBMITTED TO U.N. SECRETARY GENERAL HAMMARSKJOLD BY MAY 15 AND THE PAPERS THEMSELVES BY JULY 1.' It also notes a list of 44 paper titles and gives examples of topics (e.g., atomic waste disposal, health and safety activities in reactor plants) and which countries offered papers.
